# ggswim

**Swimmer plots with ggplot2.**

ggswim extends ggplot2 with lanes, event markers, and continuation
arrows for visualizing timelines. Build and customize your plot with
familiar layers, scales, and themes.

- Show changes over time along each lane.
- Give events their own symbols, colours, and legend.
- Add arrows to indicate ongoing activity or follow-up.

## Example: following patients through a clinical trial

Clinical trials are one application of swimmer plots. This example uses
the package’s demonstration data to show disease assessments,
reinfusions, and study outcomes. Each lane represents a patient; arrows
indicate ongoing follow-up.

![Swimmer plot of individual patient timelines. Coloured lane segments
show disease assessments, markers identify reinfusions and end-of-study
events, and arrows indicate ongoing
follow-up.](reference/figures/README-clinical-example-1.png)

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("CHOP-CGTInformatics/ggswim")
```

## Make this plot

Prepare the included datasets, then combine lanes, arrows, and markers
in a single ggplot. Each layer can use its own data while sharing the
same axes. Expand the setup block and run it before the plot code; it
creates `all_events` and `arrow_data`, which the plot needs.

**Click to expand: load packages and prepare the example data**

``` r

library(ggswim)
library(ggplot2)

all_events <- dplyr::bind_rows(infusion_events, end_study_events)

# Add arrows only for patients without an end-of-study event.
arrow_data <- patient_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::select(end_study_events, pt_id, label),
    by = "pt_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(pt_id, end_time, label) |>
  dplyr::filter(.by = pt_id, end_time == max(end_time)) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(label)) |>
  dplyr::distinct()
```

``` r

ggplot() +
  geom_swim_lane(
    data = patient_data,
    aes(x = start_time, xend = end_time, y = pt_id,
        colour = disease_assessment)
  ) +
  geom_swim_arrow(
    data = arrow_data,
    aes(xend = end_time, y = pt_id),
    arrow_head_length = grid::unit(0.15, "inches")
  ) +
  geom_swim_marker(
    data = all_events,
    aes(x = time_from_initial_infusion, y = pt_id, marker = label),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_colour_brewer(name = "Disease assessment", palette = "Set1") +
  scale_marker_discrete(
    # Match styles to event categories in the order given by limits.
    glyphs = c("⬤", "⬤", "⚠️", "❌", "✅"),
    colours = c("#ffde00", "#ed207f", NA, NA, NA),
    limits = c("First Reinfusion", "Second Reinfusion",
               "Other End Study Reason", "Deceased",
               "Completed Study Follow-Up"),
    name = "Study events"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Disease assessments and reinfusions over time",
    x = "Time since initial infusion (months)", y = "Patient ID"
  ) +
  theme_ggswim()
```

# Package index

## Layer Functions

Functions that allow you to add layers to your plot, such as lanes and
markers.

- [`geom_swim_lane()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/geom_swim_lane.md)
  : Add lanes to swimmer plots
- [`geom_swim_marker()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/geom_swim_marker.md)
  : Add markers to swimmer plots
- [`geom_swim_arrow()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/geom_swim_arrow.md)
  : Add arrows to swimmer plot lanes

## Scale Functions

Functions that assist with cleaning up the legend and assigning
aesthetic connections.

- [`scale_arrow_discrete()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/scale_arrow_discrete.md)
  : Appearance scales for discrete arrow data
- [`scale_marker_discrete()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/scale_marker_discrete.md)
  : Appearance scales for discrete marker data

## Aesthetic and Theme Functions

Functions to use icons, change the theme, and make your swimmer plot
pop!

- [`fontawesome()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/fontawesome.md)
  : Retrieve FontAwesome Unicode
- [`search_fontawesome()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/search_fontawesome.md)
  : Search for FontAwesome aliases to include in ggswim
- [`bootstrap()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/bootstrap.md)
  : Retrieve Bootstrap Unicode
- [`load_fonts()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/load_fonts.md)
  : Load Select Fonts
- [`search_bootstrap()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/search_bootstrap.md)
  : Search for Bootstrap aliases to include in ggswim
- [`theme_ggswim()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/theme_ggswim.md)
  [`theme_ggswim_dark()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/theme_ggswim.md)
  : Apply custom theme styling for ggplot2 plots

## Datasets

Example datasets for testing the package, resembling a sample
longitudinal clinical trial.

- [`patient_data`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/patient_data.md)
  : Patient Data dataset
- [`infusion_events`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/infusion_events.md)
  : Infusion Events dataset
- [`end_study_events`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/end_study_events.md)
  : End of Study Events dataset
- [`.default_glyphs`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/dot-default_glyphs.md)
  [`.default_colours`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/dot-default_glyphs.md)
  [`.default_limits`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/dot-default_glyphs.md)
  : ggswim marker defaults
- [`.default_arrow_colours`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/dot-default_arrow_colours.md)
  [`.default_arrow_fills`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/dot-default_arrow_colours.md)
  [`.default_arrow_types`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/dot-default_arrow_colours.md)
  [`.default_arrow_limits`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/ggswim/reference/dot-default_arrow_colours.md)
  : ggswim arrow defaults
